difficulty_scale.easy: One dominant signal and the shortest valid policy path.
difficulty_scale.medium: Two interacting signals or a common ecommerce presentation trap.
difficulty_scale.hard: A threshold boundary, state transition, ambiguity, or high-cardinality composition.

cases.purpose: A clearly structured adult top remains valid even when a large illustration dominates the fabric.
Modeled and close-cropped dense-print tops must not be rejected or delayed by print complexity.
Sewn textiles, pet wear, and doll-scale clothing expose the semantic boundary beyond visual clothing cues.
A single complete front-facing subject supplies an unambiguous VTO person source.
A categoryless current image with one clear person is promoted to the exclusive outfit-image path.
Multiple people, an obscured face, and a threshold-small person distinguish raw count from usable evidence and rescue logic.
A known person-free original takes the BiRefNet preparation path.
A known person-worn product takes SAM3 preparation rather than background-only extraction.
Prepared reuse, detector-unknown routing, sparse alpha, and a missing prepared fetch exercise every remaining source/evidence branch.
The basic separates flow keeps one remembered top and the current bottom in canonical order.
Footwear is retained after two separate body slots and stays in canonical accessory order.
A seven-slot separates composition covers every currently supported accessory role without duplicate Composer slots.
Technical outerwear remains a valid single upper-body slot.
Without layering, the current upper-body category replaces the competing remembered layer in either direction.
The explicit layered policy preserves top and outerwear before the lower-body slot.
A complex but complete dress selects the one-piece body mode.
An accessory current item inherits the newest remembered body mode while retaining other accessory slots.
Separates switch to one-piece, then a new top restores the remembered bottom without reviving the old top.
An explicit outfit image is one exclusive fashion asset and ignores remembered products.
A categoryless single-human product is promoted before category classification and carries person-anchored SAM3 evidence.
Multiple raw people must not promote; small or face-obscured single people exercise threshold and fallback decisions.
An obvious mechanical product is rejected at the sole category-admission boundary.
Printed home textiles must remain outside VTO even when fabric and graphic cues resemble garments.
Wrong-wearer products remain challenges while an unavailable selected remembered item fails closed without reviving an older slot winner.
